reuse.why: Delegates the whole weekend decision to the existing shared applyWeekendRule (also used by getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and schedule-template) and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule and the months day helpers.

duplication.why: No weekend or daily-skip logic is re-stated; the handler only expands the window, collects and filters.

placement.why: The handler lives next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts, mirrors its try/captureBreadcrumb pattern and is registered with its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, imports and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, readable, with a named constant explaining the window margin; weekend rule changes flow in automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses applyWeekendRule rather than re-deriving weekend handling.
